entry_before.title_zh: 元吸引子与选择条件的重建
entry_before.title_en: Meta-attractors and reproduction of selection conditions
entry_before.claim_zh: 活动后果参与重建选择该组织的条件，使其经具体承载者变化仍能接续；区分机制条件、实际边界、动力学接近及可行纠正。 新会话进一步检验精确局部目标执行怎样经制度后果进入共同损失；局部安全与共同执行保护分列。
entry_before.claim_en: Consequences help reproduce conditions selecting an organization across carrier changes; distinguish mechanism conditions, formed boundaries, dynamical approach and feasible correction. A new session tests how exact local objective fidelity can lead through institutional consequences to collective loss; local safety and joint-execution protection remain distinct.
entry_before.scope_zh: 条件构造有47项新 Lean 定理／65项声明审计，直接连接实际核心轨迹、承载者替换、供给失败、盆地、扰动及区间／延迟下的退出。另有1,681项市场及1,053项回返预算计算。相同被动轨迹不足以辨认回返来源；经验对应、更丰富承载者实现及真实干预仍开放。作者反审不冒充独立验收；目标继续。 集体破坏第一构造另有32项新定理／41项审计，检查两位置阶段最优化、正且可增长吞吐下的有限到达、精确盆地及严格保护；平局失败与无法自动恢复保留。实际人口分配／替换与纠正的共同接续仍开放。
entry_before.scope_en: 47 new Lean theorems / 65 audits connect actual core traces, carrier replacement, supply failure, basin, disturbances and exit under delay/interval uncertainty. 1,681 market and 1,053 recurrence-budget calculations supplement the proofs. Identical passive histories need not identify causal return; empirical correspondence, richer carrier realization and actual interventions remain open. Author counterreview is not independent acceptance; the goal continues. A separate first collective-destruction construction adds 32 theorems / 41 audits for two-position stage optimization, finite arrival under positive and possibly growing throughput, an exact basin and strict protection, retaining tie failure and absent automatic recovery. Actual population allocation/replacement composed with correction remains open.

entry.claim_zh: 活动后果参与重建选择该组织的条件，使其经具体承载者变化仍能接续；区分机制条件、实际边界、动力学接近及可行纠正。 新会话进一步检验精确局部目标执行怎样经制度后果进入共同损失；局部安全与共同执行保护分列。
entry.claim_en: Consequences help reproduce conditions selecting an organization across carrier changes; distinguish mechanism conditions, formed boundaries, dynamical approach and feasible correction. A new session tests how exact local objective fidelity can lead through institutional consequences to collective loss; local safety and joint-execution protection remain distinct.
entry.scope_zh: 原47项 Lean 定理／65项审计保留；新40项定理／69项审计（另54项继承审计）接通不同产出承载者、材料、实际探测、修复及后续核心轨迹。1,681项市场及1,053项回返预算计算保留。正确识别不保证还能回应，等待也可能改善可恢复探测。理论探索已到被动历史不足以辨认回返来源的边界；经验对应仍须在具体应用中检验，无普遍预警分数或独立验收主张。 集体破坏第一构造另有32项新定理／41项审计，检查两位置阶段最优化、正且可增长吞吐下的有限到达、精确盆地及严格保护；平局失败与无法自动恢复保留。实际人口分配／替换与纠正的共同接续仍开放。
entry.scope_en: The first 47 Lean theorems / 65 audits are preserved; 40 new theorems / 69 new audits, with 54 inherited audits separate, connect varied carrier yields, material, executed probing, repair and subsequent core traces. The 1,681 market and 1,053 recurrence-budget calculations retain their scope. Correct identification need not preserve response capacity; waiting can enable recoverable probing. The theoretical exploration reaches a passive-identification limit. Field correspondence remains application-specific; no universal warning score or independent acceptance is claimed. A separate first collective-destruction construction adds 32 theorems / 41 audits for two-position stage optimization, finite arrival under positive and possibly growing throughput, an exact basin and strict protection, retaining tie failure and absent automatic recovery. Actual population allocation/replacement composed with correction remains open.

shared_fragments.before: **元吸引子与生成组织 / Meta-attractors within generative activity，2026-10-08。** [当前定义](theories/meta-attractor/GENERATIVE-REGIMES.md)说明活动后果怎样重建选择组织的条件，并经具体承载者变化而回返。新增47项 Lean 定理／65项声明审计，另1,681项市场及1,053项回返／预算计算：实际核心轨迹、维护与供给失败、精确局部盆地、有界扰动、延迟和测量区间下的退出，以及同一被动轨迹的因果识别限制。[整合、证据与反审](_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/META-ATTRACTOR-INTEGRATION.md)复用已有选择器和市场机制。/ Conditional results are complete at their stated scopes; richer carrier realization, measured causal provenance and executable field interventions remain open. The active goal is preserved, with no universal warning method or independent completion acceptance claimed.
shared_fragments.after: **元吸引子与生成组织 / Meta-attractors within generative activity，2026-10-08。** [当前定义](theories/meta-attractor/GENERATIVE-REGIMES.md)说明活动后果怎样重建选择组织的条件，并经具体承载者变化而回返。原47项 Lean 定理／65项审计保留；[新40项定理／69项审计](_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/META-ATTRACTOR-CARRIER-DIAGNOSIS.md)接通不同产出承载者、材料消耗、实际探测、修复及后续回返，另54项继承审计分列。识别正确与仍能回应可以分离；等待可能改善可恢复探测。[整合与范围审计](_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/META-ATTRACTOR-INTEGRATION.md)将所请求的理论探索推进到被动历史不足以辨认回返来源的边界。/ The definition, higher-order selection, differentiated boundaries and conditional diagnosis are connected; field correspondence remains an application requirement, not an added theoretical completion gate. No universal warning score, ethical conclusion from recurrence or independent acceptance is claimed.
